description: Candidate relational predicates proposed for B1 anatomical authoring without mutating the frozen canonical relations registry.

candidate_relations.proposed_semantics: Specifies the anatomical vector or kinetic direction of translational/rotational displacement restrained by a ligament.
candidate_relations.reason_needed: Required to capture the exact mechanical stabilizing function of costoclavicular, conoid, trapezoid, and sternoclavicular ligaments.

candidate_relations.proposed_semantics: Specifies the anatomical partitioning of a synovial cavity into distinct synovial compartments by a fibrocartilaginous disc.
candidate_relations.reason_needed: Required to model the complete compartmentalization of the sternoclavicular joint into meniscoclavicular and meniscosternal cavities.

candidate_relations.proposed_semantics: Specifies that a canal, groove, triangle, or topographic space provides anatomical passage for a neurovascular bundle or vessel.
candidate_relations.reason_needed: Required to model passage of the cephalic vein in the deltopectoral groove and subclavian vessels in the cervicoaxillary canal.

candidate_relations.proposed_semantics: Specifies that a ligamentous complex provides continuous gravitational and mechanical suspension for a suspended skeletal segment.
candidate_relations.reason_needed: Essential to encode the classical Latarjet/Rouvière principle that the coracoclavicular complex suspends the scapula and free limb from the clavicle.

candidate_relations.proposed_semantics: Defines a physiological gliding interface between two muscular or osteomuscular walls separated by loose cellular connective tissue without true synovia.
candidate_relations.reason_needed: Strictly required to correctly model the scapulothoracic functional joint without falsely classifying it as a synovial articulation.
